about: Unit names printed misspelled on a source map. model/units.py reads the printed word as the listed name when it matches names across maps and to Geolex; the stored value keeps the printed text, and any value derived from the match is flagged inferred.

spellings.name: Altamaha
spellings.reason: Windsor quadrangle explanation prints 'Alamaha Formation' for the Altamaha Formation (upper Middle to lower Upper Miocene), the Geolex name used on the neighbouring quadrangle maps
